item.title: Under 18s gain last-gasp win
item.description: Millwall's Under 18s defeated AFC Bournemouth 2-1 in the Professional Development League on Saturday. A Trialist gave The Lions the lead following a through-ball from Ralphie Beckwith, only for The Cherries to equalise just before the break. Millwall were not to be denied, however, with Ayman Sheikh curling home an 89th-minute winner. Lions stopper, Justin Ndikum, saved a penalty during the game. Next up for Millwall's Under 18s is a trip to Brentford next Saturday. Millwall: Ndikum, Payton, Dix

item.title: Lionesses reach Football League Trophy Semi-Finals
item.description: Millwall Lionesses advanced to the Semi-Finals of the London & South East Regional Women's Football League Trophy on Sunday with a 3-2 Quarter-Final win at Dorking Wanderers. Ted Jones' side fell behind at Meadowbank Stadium just before the half-hour mark, but Maisie Joyce's equaliser in first-half stoppage-time ensured the sides went in level at the break. item.title: Wes Harding joins Plymouth Argyle on loan
item.description: Wes Harding has joined Plymouth Argyle on loan until the end of the 2025/26 campaign. The right-back, who has made 11 appearances for The Lions across all competitions this season, will now join up with the Sky Bet League One side for the remainder of the season. Argyle, currently in 14th place in the third tier, will have Harding amongst their ranks for Saturday's visit of Lincoln City. item.title: Aidomo Emakhu joins Oxford United
item.description: Millwall Football Club can confirm that Aidomo Emakhu has joined Oxford United on a permanent transfer, for an undisclosed fee. The attacker made 82 appearances for The Lions in all competitions after joining from Shamrock Rovers in 2023, scoring three times, including in the 4-0 win over Charlton Athletic last month. Everyone at The Den would like to thank Aidomo for his efforts whilst in SE16 and wishes him the best for the future.

item.title: Barnet loan for Jack Howland
item.description: Jack Howland has joined Barnet on loan until the end of the 2025/26 season. The 19-year-old winger, who has made three Cup appearances for The Lions this season and has also featured in numerous matchday squads in the Sky Bet Championship, will spend the rest of the campaign with the Sky Bet League Two side. item.title: Millwall Lionesses announce Homewood Solutions as back-of-short sponsor
item.description: Millwall Lionesses is delighted to announce Homewood Solutions as their new back-of-short sponsor. The Lionesses switched from the more traditional white shorts to navy – which followed consultation with players and management back in 2023 and has been made because wearing the former while on a period is an issue which has been widely highlighted by women throughout all sport. Homewood Solutions sponsorship enables Millwall Lionesses to once again play in navy shorts. Millwall FC First-Team Kit

item.title: Millwall host Memorial Day at The Den
item.description: Millwall Football Club hosted its annual Memorial Day at The Den on Saturday. Prior to kick-off against Sheffield United, names sent into the club were displayed on the big screen, with two wreaths laid in the centre-circle - one from The Lions and one from Millwall Supporters' Club. A minute's applause was also carried out, with the names also present in the Online Match Pack and on social media, with a video and gallery able to be seen below. Once A Lion, Always A Lion. Millwall Football Club

item.title: Mihailo Ivanovic scores Millwall's 9,000th competitive goal
item.description: Mihailo Ivanovic scored Millwall Football Club's 9,000th competitive goal last Saturday. The 19th-minute equaliser against Sheffield United at The Den saw the Serbian striker score The Lions' landmark goal, following on from Femi Azeez's strike against Stoke City in October; Millwall's 6,000th Football League strike. Congratulations, Miha - and here's to many more goals!

item.title: Two new additions to Loan Watch!
item.description: There was a mixed bag of results for Millwall's loanees last weekend. The only winner was Ben Drake with Braintree Town, as the Essex outfit were 2-1 winners over Eastleigh at home in the Enterprise National League; the left-back playing the full game in the victory. Elsewhere, there was a draw for Frankie Baker and Tonbridge Angels as they were held 1-1 at home by Maidstone United in the Enterprise National League South.
